steps.title: Load samples and reagents
steps.instruction: Place cell‑lysate samples, Thermo Fisher Dynabeads Protein A or G, and the specific antibody into a 96‑well deep‑well working plate on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Move plate to magnetic module
steps.instruction: Transfer the working plate containing the bead‑antibody‑sample complex to the magnetic module located in slot 1 to begin Part 2.

steps.title: Remove supernatant with 8‑channel pipette
steps.instruction: With the magnetic module engaged, use the 8‑channel pipette to aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: First wash: add buffer and resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash of the bead complex.

substeps.instruction: Transfer wash buffer from the reagent plate in slot 2 to each well of the working plate (slot 1) using the 8‑channel pipette.
Resuspend the precipitated beads by mixing.
Re‑engage the magnetic module to re‑precipitate the beads.
Remove the wash supernatant with the 8‑channel pipette (tips are retained for subsequent washes).

steps.title: Repeat wash two additional times
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash procedure described in the previous step two more times, for a total of three washes, using the same 8‑channel pipette tips.

steps.title: Add elution buffer from slot 4
steps.instruction: Transfer elution buffer from the reagent plate in slot 4 to the washed beads in the working plate (slot 1) using the 8‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Mix and transfer eluate to final plate
steps.instruction: Combine the beads with the elution buffer and move the eluate to the final plate.

substeps.instruction: Mix beads and elution buffer thoroughly with the 8‑channel pipette.
Transfer the mixed eluate to the final plate located in slot 3 using the same 8‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Seal and heat at 70 °C for 10 min
steps.instruction: Seal the final plate, place it on the temperature module, and heat at 70 °C for 10 minutes to denature proteins.
